Maya Patel: Quick heads up — we confirmed an embeddings quality regression affecting onboarding batch jobs for ~12 trial tenants (US + EU). Seeing elevated semantic-match noise and some embeddings failing similarity thresholds. PR introduced during model rollout v2 on 2024-06-10.
Liam Chen: Got it. Any scope on which tenants? severity? ETA for fix?
Maya Patel: Affected list is in the spreadsheet (internal): https://redwood.app/sheets/emb-regression-A. Severity: medium-high for search/retrieval flows, mostly onboarding ingestion from our batch pipeline. Engineering is running a rollback + re-encode; ETA for first rerun: ~6 hours.
Iris Gomez: CS needs a tailored comm for affected customers. Drafted a short email + offer for remediation. Posting below — please review language and add any customer-specific notes. We should offer: two-week usage credit, priority 1:1 office hours with SE, and a free reindex. Also propose a live migration session if they want.
Iris Gomez:
```Subject: Update on onboarding ingestion for your trial
Hi {{first_name}},

We wanted to let you know we found an issue that impacted the quality of embeddings generated during onboarding for a subset of trials, including yours. We've identified the root cause, and engineering is rolling back the change and reprocessing affected items. What we're offering you now:
• Two weeks of complimentary credits to offset any disruption
• A priority 1:1 office hours session with a Solutions Engineer to walk through any gaps
• A free reindex of your onboarding data once the fix is complete

ETA for reprocessing: within 6–8 hours. We'll follow up once your tenant is reindexed and provide a short verification checklist you can run.

If you'd like to schedule the office hours or want us to prioritize any particular dataset, reply and we'll set it up.

Thanks for your patience — we know this is disruptive. We're committed to making it right.

Best,
Iris on behalf of Redwood Inference Customer Success
```
Ava Torres: LGTM. Two notes: add a short one-line status link and preserve legal-approved credit language. Maybe: "We will apply a two-week credit to your account; no action required." And add a point about refresh tokens if they use cached embeddings.
Maya Patel: Good call. Also add: "If you use prefix caching, please invalidate those prefixes after we finish reindexing."
ops-bot: Incident update — rollback started at 2024-06-11T02:10:00Z, current progress: 30% re-encodes complete. (inc-2024-06-11-emb-regen)
Liam Chen: Thanks @ops-bot. Iris — can CS team start personalized outreach for top 5 trial accounts (revenue/expansion signal) once engineering confirms reindex complete? I can own scheduling office hours for those.
Iris Gomez: Yes — please own the top-5 outreach. I'll prepare personalized notes per account with proposed credit amounts. Sending cadence: initial heads-up + follow-up after reindex + verification checklist.
Ava Torres: I'll queue the email drafts in HubSpot and tag them "Embeddings Regression — High Touch". @Maya, can you pull the customer list and flag any legal/reg compliance notes? 
Maya Patel: On it — pulling list now. Expect to share by 02:25Z. Also prepping a short FAQ snippet for the email.
Liam Chen: One more ask — can we add a short technical blurb for customers who want more details (non-sensitive): cause = model variant mismatch + quantization mismatch in the rollout; mitigation = rollback + re-encode with validated kernel selection. Keep it high-level.
Iris Gomez: Perfect. I'll include a 1-paragraph technical appendix for customers who ask. 
Maya Patel: Shared the customer list and draft FAQ: https://redwood.app/drive/emb-affected-list. Sending to top-5 now in DM for personalization.
deploy-bot: Automations: scheduled re-encode job id=job-4421, estimated finish in 4.5h. Logs: https://redwood.app/logs/job-4421
Liam Chen: Great. Plan: 1) initial email within 30m, 2) follow-up with confirmation + verification checklist after reindex, 3) offer office hours + apply credits automatically. Owners: Iris = email drafts & personalization, Liam = scheduling office hours, Ava = send + hubspot tagging, Maya = customer list & compliance check, Eng = finalize re-encode.
Iris Gomez: Thx team. I'll post final email copy in #customer-success-drafts and cc @legal for the credit language. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Closing loop: please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your part so we can mark the incident comms done.
Liam Chen: ✅
